decentralized.title: Fully Decentralized
decentralized.description: Smart contracts, transparent treasury logic, and auditable state changes stay visible end to end.

secure.title: Highly Secure
secure.description: Escrow-sensitive flows and wallet actions are routed through explicit on-chain permissions.

transparent.title: 100% Transparent
transparent.description: Campaign state, governance outcomes, and bridge requests can be reviewed without hidden logic.

homePage.featureBodyTransparent: Thresholds, voting windows, and contract surfaces stay readable inside the product.
